metadata.schema_version: v2 (sampled Tb + sampled core + derived rho_sil)
metadata.description: Phase C1 BodyConfig: Ganymede with pure H2O ocean and Andrade rheology. HP ice shell present (Ice III/V/VI locked together via param_groups). 8D problem. Observable expansion (C2-A): added Re_k2/Im_k2 (Mazarico 2023, k2≈0.2±0.05; Im_k2 default 0±0.05), Re_h2/Im_h2 (Mazarico 2023, h2≈+1.12±0.10; Im_h2 default 0±0.10). Same values for all three bodies as placeholders pending body-specific updates. J2/C22 were specified earlier but DROPPED from this config: PP currently has no forward model for the static gravity coefficients — Planet.J2/C22 are observation inputs, not predictions. Future work: build a generalized gravity-coefficient forward model that produces J_n and C_nm/S_nm to arbitrary degree/order for bodies with high-resolution gravity (Mars, Moon, Enceladus). Magnetic induction wired (C2-B) but observable values not yet specified; add Ae_<label>_real / Ae_<label>_imag (or BiAmp_<label> / BiPhase_<label>_deg) keys to enable induction in the likelihood.
metadata.primary_constraint: CMR2 from Schubert et al. (2004), Jupiter system chapter
metadata.k2_status: NOT INCLUDED - no published k2 measurement for Ganymede. JUICE will provide constraints (~2034). Add to observables once available.
metadata.Tb_bounds_rationale: Tb_K=[251.5, 267.5] K targets the geological-likely range D_iceIh=[~50, ~149] km with D_ocean spanning [12.3, ~412] km. Lower bound: 251.5 K is just above TtripleIh_III_L_K=251.165 K and gives D_ocean=12.3 km — within the user's 'within 10 km of frozen' spec for Ganymede. Upper bound: 267.5 K gives D_iceIh~50 km (probed: Tb=267 → D_iceIh=53 km, Tb=268 → 46 km). Probed via PlanetProfile.Inference.find_tb_bounds, 2026-05-23.
metadata.core_bounds_rationale: R_core in [0, 0.5 R_body] permits the no-core limit; rho_core in [5000, 8000] kg/m^3 brackets metallic Fe / Fe-S compositions. rho_sil is derived from M_total mass conservation given the cached ice+ocean profile and sampled core; samples with rho_sil outside [2200, 3500] kg/m^3 are rejected by the likelihood.
metadata.next_step_after_C1: Per-composition runs by adding 0.1 molal increments of NaCl to the ocean using the SeaFreeze NaCl representation (deferred - not part of Phase C1).
metadata.stage2_dependencies: Toolkit must (a) parse the derived_params block, (b) implement the rho_sil mass-conservation solver and rejection, (c) extend the structure cache to include M_ice_kg / M_ocean_kg / R_oceanbot_m / M_total_kg per Tb point, (d) recompute CMR2 from the sampled core + derived rho_sil + cached ice/ocean profile.
metadata.stage3_dependencies: Build Tb-grid structure cache for Ganymede with pure H2O ocean across the sampled Tb range.
